answer: Sybil resistance via geometric identity spacing: each identity claims a vertex of POA in a trellis-dimensional reputation lattice, where voting power is a function of independent coordinate proofs across trellis epochs. To trellis N sybils, an attacker must solve N independent hollow-proof challenges, each requiring distinct spatial commitments, so cost scales with N while honest agents claim one vertex and accumulate lattice weight. Slashing burns any identity caught occupying multiple lattice coordinates simultaneously.
